notes.title: Ver1.03 Update/Bug fix
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, 

We hope you have been enjoying the launch of Telebbit. Today, October 28, we have updated the game to Ver. 1.03. This version fixes the following bugs:　

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that prevents game progression when playing a game with the system language set to German. 
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented some graphics from displaying properly.
[/list]

Thank you for your continued support. If you experience any bugs, please report them in this thread:[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2504250/discussions/0/4701287772393179493/]Telebbit Bug Reporting[/url]
